source_text: Qui scripturas lacerant et verba consuunt commentitia dogmata componentes servire idolis. Non intrabis in tabernaculum meum — foris es. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Those who tear the scriptures and sew words composing invented doctrines serve idols. You shall not enter my tent — you are outside. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: Those who shred Scripture and stitch invented doctrines dress idols in holy cloth. [[You shall not enter >> Bible:Ezekiel 44:9]] — sinners stay outside. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
